sn54.10:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kimilāyaṃ viharati veḷuvane.
sn54.10:1.3: tatra kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ kimilaṃ āmantesi
sn54.10:1.4: kathaṃ bhāvito nu kho kimila ānāpānassatisamādhi kathaṃ bahulīkato mahapphalo hoti mahānisaṃsoti.
sn54.10:2.1: evaṃ vutte āyasmā kimilo tuṇhī ahosi.
sn54.10:2.3: tatiyampi kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ kimilaṃ āmantesi
sn54.10:2.4: kathaṃ bhāvito nu kho kimila ānāpānassatisamādhi kathaṃ bahulīkato mahapphalo hoti mahānisaṃsoti.
sn54.10:2.5: tatiyampi kho āyasmā kimilo tuṇhī ahosi.
sn54.10:3.1: evaṃ vutte āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn54.10:3.2: etassa bhagavā kālo etassa sugata kālo
sn54.10:3.3: yaṃ bhagavā ānāpānassatisamādhiṃ bhāseyya bhagavato sutvā bhikkhū dhāressantīti.
sn54.10:4.2: evaṃ bhanteti kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato paccassosi.
sn54.10:4.4: kathaṃ bhāvito ca ānanda ānāpānassatisamādhi kathaṃ bahulīkato mahapphalo hoti mahānisaṃso.
sn54.10:4.5: idhānanda bhikkhu araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā suññāgāragato vā nisīdati pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyaṃ paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvā.
sn54.10:4.7: paṭinissaggānupassī assasissāmīti sikkhati paṭinissaggānupassī passasissāmīti sikkhati.
sn54.10:4.8: evaṃ bhāvito kho ānanda ānāpānassatisamādhi evaṃ bahulīkato mahapphalo hoti mahānisaṃso.
sn54.10:5.1: yasmiṃ samaye ānanda bhikkhu dīghaṃ vā assasanto dīghaṃ assasāmīti pajānāti dīghaṃ vā passasanto dīghaṃ passasāmīti pajānāti.
sn54.10:5.2: rassaṃ vā assasanto rassaṃ assasāmīti pajānāti rassaṃ vā passasanto rassaṃ passasāmīti pajānāti.
sn54.10:5.3: sabbakāyapaṭisaṃvedī assasissāmīti sikkhati sabbakāyapaṭisaṃvedī passasissāmīti sikkhati.
sn54.10:5.4: passambhayaṃ kāyasaṅkhāraṃ assasissāmīti sikkhati passambhayaṃ kāyasaṅkhāraṃ passasissāmīti sikkhati.
sn54.10:5.5: kāye kāyānupassī ānanda bhikkhu tasmiṃ samaye viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomassaṃ.
sn54.10:5.7: kāyaññatarāhaṃ ānanda etaṃ vadāmi yadidaṃ assāsappassāsaṃ.
sn54.10:5.8: tasmā tihānanda kāye kāyānupassī bhikkhu tasmiṃ samaye viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn54.10:6.1: yasmiṃ samaye ānanda bhikkhu pītipaṭisaṃvedī assasissāmīti sikkhati pītipaṭisaṃvedī passasissāmīti sikkhati.
sn54.10:6.2: sukhapaṭisaṃvedī assasissāmīti sikkhati sukhapaṭisaṃvedī passasissāmīti sikkhati.
sn54.10:6.3: cittasaṅkhārapaṭisaṃvedī assasissāmīti sikkhati cittasaṅkhārapaṭisaṃvedī passasissāmīti sikkhati. passambhayaṃ cittasaṅkhāraṃ assasissāmīti sikkhati
sn54.10:6.5: vedanāsu vedanānupassī ānanda bhikkhu tasmiṃ samaye viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn54.10:6.7: vedanāññatarāhaṃ ānanda etaṃ vadāmi yadidaṃ assāsappassāsānaṃ sādhukaṃ manasikāraṃ.
sn54.10:6.8: tasmā tihānanda vedanāsu vedanānupassī bhikkhu tasmiṃ samaye viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn54.10:7.1: yasmiṃ samaye ānanda bhikkhu cittapaṭisaṃvedī assasissāmīti sikkhati cittapaṭisaṃvedī passasissāmīti sikkhati.
sn54.10:7.4: vimocayaṃ cittaṃ assasissāmīti sikkhati vimocayaṃ cittaṃ passasissāmīti sikkhati.
sn54.10:7.5: citte cittānupassī ānanda bhikkhu tasmiṃ samaye viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn54.10:7.7: nāhaṃ ānanda muṭṭhassatissa asampajānassa ānāpānassatisamādhibhāvanaṃ vadāmi.
sn54.10:7.8: tasmā tihānanda citte cittānupassī bhikkhu tasmiṃ samaye viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādosanassaṃ.
sn54.10:8.1: yasmiṃ samaye ānanda bhikkhu aniccānupassī assasissāmīti sikkhati …pe…
sn54.10:8.4: paṭinissaggānupassī assasissāmīti sikkhati paṭinissaggānupassī passasissāmīti sikkhati.
sn54.10:8.5: dhammesu dhammānupassī ānanda bhikkhu tasmiṃ samaye viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn54.10:8.6: so yantaṃ hoti abhijjhādomanassānaṃ pahānaṃ tampaññāya disvā sādhukaṃ ajjhupekkhitā hoti.
sn54.10:8.7: tasmā tihānanda dhammesu dhammānupassī bhikkhu tasmiṃ samaye viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn54.10:9.2: puratthimāya cepi disāya āgaccheyya sakaṭaṃ vā ratho vā upahanateva taṃ paṃsupuñjaṃ.
sn54.10:9.5: dakkhiṇāya cepi disāya āgaccheyya sakaṭaṃ vā ratho vā upahanateva taṃ paṃsupuñjaṃ.
sn54.10:9.6: evameva kho ānanda bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharantopi upahanateva pāpake akusale dhamme.
sn54.10:9.9: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharantopi upahanateva pāpake akusale dhammeti.
